corrections.reason: The word wraps across L14-L15 as 'ሂደ↵ህ' (converb 'having gone'). In L14 the final glyph is 1st-order 'ደ' (ሂደ-ህ), not 6th-order 'ድ'.
The printed word is 'ቁም' (as in 'ምን ቁም ነገር ናቸው', matching Col 2 L30-31), with the wide labiovelar/serif of 'ቍ/ቁ' misread as two letters 'ቁሩ'.
In the zoomed image, the middle character of 'ሰዓት' is the triangular Pharyngeal 'ዓ', not 'አ'.
In the Ge'ez Gospel text ('ረከቦ ለወልዱ ሕያወ', accusative state, glossed in L33-34 where both 'ሐይዎ' and 'ሕያወ' are contrasted), the printed glyph in L32 is 1st-order 'ወ'.
